title: Smoked Pork Roulade with Vanilla Cream
description: A classic French dish featuring a slow-cooked smoked pork roll, served with a rich vanilla cream sauce.
instructions: Season the pork loin with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat. Add the pork loin and sear until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork loin to a baking dish and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Slowly pour in 1 cup of milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the vanilla extract and grated Slovakian cheese until melted and smooth.
Roll out the long grain rice on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Place the rice on top of the pork loin, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Roll the pork loin tightly and secure with kitchen twine.
Place the roulade in the oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving with the vanilla cream sauce.
